name: What are the standard steps in the kitchen addition construction process?

mainEntity.name: What are the standard steps in the kitchen addition construction process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen additions typically progress through design, engineering, permitting, foundation excavation, framing, rough-in mechanicals, insulation, drywall, and finish carpentry. After pouring the foundation and framing exterior walls, trade specialists run rough plumbing, electrical wiring, and HVAC ductwork before city inspections occur. Once rough-in approvals are complete, insulation and drywall are hung, followed by cabinet installation, countertop templating, flooring, fixture trim-outs, and final building and trade inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes design, permitting, foundation work, framing, mechanical rough-ins, inspections, drywall, finish carpentry, and final sign-offs.
